newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products up with crude, but markets thin.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products up with crude, but markets thin.

text.p: NWE oil products were boosted by crude futures in thin markets on Friday.
Gasoline prices were little changed but swaps rose $2 a tonne to catch up with Thursday's gains.
Naphtha gained $1 or so a tonne, falling into line with the rise in crude. Gas oil was also pulled nearly $2 a tonne higher by firmer futures and showed steady premiums in a thin end-of-week market.

Fuel oil barges were pushed $4 higher by crude, stronger swaps and runaway Singapore prices. It slipped back $1 to $85/$85 after healthy trade in a market thinned by holidays and an industry gathering.
